featured_reviews.name: Siddhartha Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great learning experience with Ram Sir during my driving training. He is very patient, professional, and explains every driving concept clearly. His guidance helped me build confidence on the road and improve my driving skills significantly.

What I appreciated most was his calm nature and willingness to correct mistakes without making me feel nervous. He focused on road safety, proper vehicle control, parking techniques, and traffic rules, ensuring that I was well-prepared for real-world driving.

Thanks to his training, I now feel much more comfortable and confident behind the wheel. I would highly recommend Ram Sir to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and supportive driving instructor.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great learning experience with Kotian Training School, especially with Ram Sir (Master Ji). When you start learning to drive, the biggest challenge is overcoming fear and gaining confidence on the road. Ram Sir focuses exactly on that. He patiently guides you through real driving situations, teaches practical road sense, and helps you stay calm behind the wheel.
What I liked most was that he never made me feel nervous, even when I made mistakes. His instructions are clear, and he gives you enough control to learn by actually driving rather than just watching. Because of his experience, he knows how to build confidence step by step, whether it's handling traffic, taking turns or driving on busy roads.
If you're someone who feels anxious about driving, learning from Ram Sir will definitely make the process easier and more enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Ayush
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience learning at this car training school. The instructors are very patient, supportive, and teach everything properly without rushing. They make beginners feel comfortable and confident while driving. Special mention to Ram Sir — he was genuinely amazing and really cool to learn with. His teaching style was easy to understand, and he always stayed calm and encouraging. You can tell the teachers here actually care about helping students improve. Overall, definitely one of the best driving schools and highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: L k
featured_reviews.review_text:
If u want to learn or even perfect your driving skills this is the place to be.... The driving trainer Mr. Ram Sir stands for 3 P's which is perfection, professional and patient ..... He is just too good a teacher ... I had a good 21 days of excellent training... I had learnt driving a few years back from another place but I don't think I was even close to confident back then.... Now with Ram Sir's training I'm kind of confident and also satisfied with all that I learnt.... Ram Sir is super patient and also he is so flexible with timings .... And to top it all the class is fun because of his good sense of humour....i was so scared initially when I started off but with all the training i became quite confident... With his commendable teaching skills and knowledge I'm no more scared to drive ... It is easy to learn something and excel but teaching is something that everyone can't do... And I would definitely say that Ram Sir is a fantastic and fabulous teacher.... I would definitely recommend kotain driving school to all and also the driving teacher Mr. Ram Sir.
Thankyou very much 🙏🏻🙂

featured_reviews.name: Jay Bhurke
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience at Kotian Driving as I learnt how to drive a 4-wheeler there recently along with my sister. The charges are quite affordable too and they provide complete assistance for all types of formalities like learning license, permanent license, RTO booking, etc. Kudos to Kotian sir and Darshana ma'am for all the processes!

The instructor over there - Ram sir, is just the besttt!! A great teacher and very encouraging and cheerful while training! He is quite knowledgeable about driving techniques and his method of correcting his learners is also very friendly! He is always joking and never makes you feel overwhelmed at the wheel! Loved learning from him!! I would definitely recommend him to new learners!! Perfect driving GURU and side-seat guide!!

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Aher
featured_reviews.review_text: My confidence on the road has shot up thanks to Kotian Driving Classes. Ram Sir has this great way of breaking down complicated steps into simple, clear instructions that actually stick. What really made a difference for me was his focus on total car control and building good habits rather than just trying to go fast. One specific trick—mastering the timing between the brake and the gas—was a total game-changer for my coordination. If you want to learn to drive safely and correctly, you should definitely go to Ram Sir!

featured_reviews.name: Kavita Devadiga
featured_reviews.review_text: Mr. Ram Prajapati Sir at Kotian Motor Training School is an excellent driving instructor. He is very experienced and highly skilled, and he knows exactly how to build confidence in learners. He keeps us relaxed while driving, clearly points out the areas we need to focus on, and constantly encourages us to do better. His cheerful and humorous nature really helps ease the tension, especially for beginners. He also shares his personal experiences, and real-life incidents on the road to help us understand driving better. I highly recommend him to anyone learning to drive.

featured_reviews.name: swastik ganguly
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unlike most people, I decided to take up driving late in life. Initially, I was hesitant and approached the first day of my training full of apprehension.

I just finished my sessions at Kotian Motor Training School, and the experience was super smooth. All thanks go to Ram Prajapati. From day one, his approach was not just to teach me a skill, but to carefully curate sessions that worked for me. He has a remarkable ability to explain concepts to a new learner, guide them through the journey, and, above all, instill confidence.

Some of the insights he shared will stay with me for as long as I drive. I truly owe it to Ram Sir (as he is affectionately known) for helping me acquire this new skill at this point in my life. I will remain grateful to him and Kotian Motor Training School for this wonderful experience !!

featured_reviews.name: Kamran Alam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled at the NEW INDIA MOTOR TRAINING SCHOOL for the 20-day four-wheeler course feeling completely hopeless. Honestly, I genuinely believed I would never be able to drive a car. The thought of navigating Mumbai traffic was terrifying.
However, the 17 days that followed completely changed my life.
The instructors here are absolutely brilliant. They don't just teach you how to operate a car; they teach you how to be confident and safe on the road. The training was structured, patient, and focused entirely on real-world application. They systematically broke down every element, from clutch control to lane changing, making the process far less intimidating than I imagined.
The ultimate test came on Day 17. I had been driving under supervision, but that day, I drove all alone to Bandra Terminus to pick up my brother. If you know Bandra Terminus, you know that's not a spot for nervous drivers! It was an incredibly proud moment. Everyone in my family was thrilled that I was capable of making such a complex, independent trip after such a short time.
The NEW INDIA MOTOR TRAINING SCHOOL didn't just teach me a skill; they gave me a huge boost of self-confidence and freedom. If you're starting from zero, struggling with fear, or think driving is impossible for you—sign up here. They will prove you wrong. Highly, highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience learning the basics of car driving. The owners are polite, supportive, and explain the entire process clearly. From day one, the environment made me feel comfortable and confident.
Trainer Chandhan is truly a champion. Right from the first day, he instilled confidence and taught driving skills in a very clear and practical manner. His approach makes learning easy and stress-free.
I highly recommend this driving school to anyone looking to learn driving with confidence and proper guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Dwivedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience learning to drive! The instructors Mr Javed were patient, professional, and very knowledgeable. They explained everything clearly and made sure I felt confident behind the wheel. The lessons were well-structured, covering everything from basic controls to real-world driving scenarios.

Thanks to their guidance, I now feel comfortable and safe on the road. I highly recommend to anyone looking for quality driving lessons!

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Gulnaz

featured_reviews.name: TUSHAR PATEL
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent service! I chose them for both the driving classes and the RTO process for my license. The entire process, from training to receiving my Driving License, was handled quickly and efficiently was very helpful and professional. Got my license without any hassle!

featured_reviews.name: Usman Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing experience learning car driving from one of the most patient and professional instructors I’ve ever met. Every session was well-planned, calm, and full of practical tips that made driving feel easy and natural. What really stood out was the personal attention and the way even small mistakes were corrected with clarity and kindness — no stress, no pressure.🩵

Thanks to this training, I now drive with complete confidence on the road. If you’re looking to learn driving the right way, I highly recommend joining here. You won’t just learn to drive — you’ll learn to drive safely, smoothly, and confidently. Trust me, it's totally worth it! ✅

featured_reviews.name: Pranjann Bakle
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently completed my driving lessons at Marol Driving School , and overall, it was a very positive experience. The instructors were, patient, and knowledgeable. They focused on building my confidence behind the wheel and made sure I understood the rules of the road thoroughly.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: Learned driving at Marol Motor Training School and it was a fantastic experience! Huge shoutout to my awesome trainers, Chandan and Javed — super patient, super chill, and total confidence boosters. They somehow managed to turn a nervous newbie into someone who now feels ready to drive anything from a hatchback to a spaceship (okay, maybe not a spaceship… yet). They covered everything from the basics to advanced skills in no time. Highly recommend if you want to learn driving without losing your cool (or the clutch)!

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: It was nice learning experience. Trainer Javed is very cool. He always remain calm even if we stall the car in heavy traffic. Also taught to do proper parking and also learnt to drive on hills. I would highly recommend Marol Motor Training School to new learners.
